description_en: Retrieves a list of ticket templates
description_zh: 使用ListTickerTemplate获取工单模板列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-ticket-templates --search-pattern '模板1' --category-id 43c2671b-0000000086d0-6bd187905cc8 --state Enabled --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --instance-id ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTicketTemplates

parameters.help_en: The name of the template. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.name: search_pattern

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ticket category
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the template.

- Enabled: The template is published.

- Disabled: The template is unpublished
parameters.help_zh:
模板状态。
- Enabled（已上线）
- Disabled（已下线）
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be between 1 and 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be between 1 and 100
parameters.name: page_size
